title: Takuya Nemoto: public profile and its verification
description:
The static site of the author's public profile, the tools that run in it, and the checks on the site itself, including a cross-check of the author's ten repositories. The site makes one claim at the top (the assumption ‖DQ‖₂ < 1 in the Trinity-Infinity papers is sufficient but not necessary) and carries the procedure to refute it on the same page.

No preprint by the author has been peer-reviewed. A DOI does not mean peer review.

Site: https://cpsbvbng26-dotcom.vercel.app/
